purpose: Maps an EU AI Act risk tier (derived from an upstream classifier such as the AI Act high-risk fit diagnostic) to the European Commission's Model Contractual AI Clauses (MCC-AI) template selection: High-Risk or Light, plus the applicable Chapter III clause set (transparency, risk management, data governance, human oversight, cybersecurity for High-Risk; a reduced set for Light). Reference mode only: MCC-AI redistribution terms are unclear, so this node selects and points to the official source rather than vendoring clause text. Not legal advice.
